items.title: Button
items.description: A clear, responsive action with quiet secondary states.

items.title: Action button
items.description: A compact button for frequent toolbar actions.

items.title: Split button
items.description: A primary action with a menu of nearby alternatives.

items.title: Button group
items.description: Related actions joined into one surface with hairline dividers: a hover highlight glides between segments, the pressed one answers in place, and an attached menu can close the row.

items.title: Floating button group
items.description: Separate soft buttons in a quiet tray, with one shared highlight that morphs from button to button as you move, and a pressed state that settles in place.

items.title: Expanding button group
items.description: Icon buttons in a compact group: the one you point at or focus grows to reveal its label while its neighbours slide aside, and an action confirms in place.

items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copy a value with immediate confirmation.

items.title: Action swap
items.description: Swap an action label while preserving its place and intent.

items.title: Icon morph
items.description: Icons that morph between states: menu to close, play to pause, copy to check, and more.

items.title: Confirm morph
items.description: A destructive button that morphs into an inline confirmation, a spinner, and a result with undo.

items.title: Theme switcher
items.description: Four smooth ways to move between light and dark appearance.

items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Confirm a destructive action by holding, not tapping.

items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: Reveal row actions with a swipe, or from the same actions in a menu.

items.title: Reactions
items.description: Acknowledge a post in one tap, with counts that roll.

items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A focused list of actions anchored to a trigger.

items.title: Context menu
items.description: Secondary actions kept close to the selected object.

items.title: User menu
items.description: Your account, settings, theme, and sign out behind the avatar.

items.title: Input
items.description: A single line field with clear labels and useful states.

items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline field for notes, descriptions, and longer text.

items.title: Password field
items.description: Capture sensitive text with a visible reveal control.

items.title: Password strength
items.description: Show how strong a new password is while it is typed.

items.title: Search field
items.description: A recognizable search entry point with clear affordances.

items.title: Expanding search
items.description: An icon that morphs into a search field with results beneath it.

items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Rename in place: the text becomes a field without moving.

items.title: Number field
items.description: Enter a bounded number with clear increment controls.

items.title: Money input
items.description: A currency field with live grouping, stable width, rolling digits, and minor-unit output.

items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone field with a country picker, formatting as you type, and E.164 output.

items.title: Scrub input
items.description: A Figma-style number field: drag the label to scrub, or type values, units, and arithmetic.

items.title: Tag input
items.description: Turn short text values into removable tags.

items.title: Mention input
items.description: A textarea with @people and #channel mentions that act as single tokens, with suggestions at the caret.

items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: Record key combinations into key caps, with conflict warnings, Kbd, and a searchable cheatsheet.

items.title: Select
items.description: A compact choice field with a keyboard friendly menu.

items.title: Combobox
items.description: Search and select from a list without leaving the field.

items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Select several values while keeping the field readable.

items.title: Morph select
items.description: A select whose trigger grows into the list, with a gliding highlight and type-ahead.

items.title: Chip group
items.description: Filter by a few facets with chips that morph as you pick them.

items.title: Radio cards
items.description: Selectable option cards with a sliding selection ring, price and description slots, and radio keyboard behavior.

items.title: Billing toggle
items.description: A monthly and yearly switch with a savings badge and prices that roll to the new amount.

items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary choice with a precise, legible state.

items.title: Radio group
items.description: Choose one option from a visible set.

items.title: Switch
items.description: A tactile toggle for settings that take effect immediately.

items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Switch between a small set of related views.

items.title: Rating
items.description: A simple, accessible way to capture a numeric opinion.

items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value or a range on a track that follows your finger.

items.title: Elastic slider
items.description: A slider that stretches like rubber past its ends, with a swaying value tag and detents the thumb clicks into.

items.title: Range histogram slider
items.description: A price range over a live histogram of the data, lighting the bars inside the range and settling on bar edges.

items.title: Calendar
items.description: Browse dates in a clear, compact month view.

items.title: Date picker
items.description: Choose a date without losing context.

items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A range picker that grows from its trigger into two months with presets and a stretching range highlight.

items.title: Time picker
items.description: Choose a time with sensible keyboard behavior.

items.title: Color picker
items.description: A swatch that grows into a picker with format morphing, eyedropper, saved swatches, and contrast readout.

items.title: Emoji picker
items.description: A full emoji picker with instant search, scroll-synced categories, skin tones, recently used emoji, and a virtualized, keyboard-navigable grid.

items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: A lightweight editor with markdown shortcuts, a floating toolbar, a slash menu, and HTML and markdown output.

items.title: Signature pad
items.description: Smooth ink that thins with speed, with undo, replay, and PNG or SVG export.

items.title: File dropzone
items.description: A generous target for dropping one or more files.

items.title: Avatar upload
items.description: Click or drop a photo onto the avatar to crop it in place with drag, pinch and zoom.

items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related content in the same context.

items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Show where a page sits in a hierarchy.

items.title: Pagination
items.description: Move through a long collection with clear bounds.

items.title: Mega menu morph
items.description: A site header whose menus share one floating panel.

items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A native scroll container with thin overlay scrollbars and edge fades that appear only when content overflows.

items.title: Accordion
items.description: Progressively reveal supporting information in place.

items.title: Expandable card
items.description: Give a dense card more room when requested.

items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Trade space between panes by dragging the divider between them.

items.title: Expandable text
items.description: Long text clamped to a few lines with a soft fade that glides open with Read more and closes with Show less, shown only when the text overflows.

items.title: Dialog
items.description: A focused surface for decisions that need attention.

items.title: Drawer
items.description: A temporary side surface for focused work.

items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A sheet that rests at a peek or full height and follows your finger.

items.title: Popover
items.description: A small anchored surface for contextual information.

items.title: Hover card
items.description: Preview a person or link on hover or focus without leaving the page.

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short supporting text for unfamiliar controls.

items.title: Share access
items.description: A share panel: invite people as validated email chips with suggestions, change roles from a compact menu, remove with undo, switch link access and copy the link, with every change landing in place.

items.title: Alert
items.description: A persistent message that helps people recover or continue.

items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief confirmation for a completed background action.

items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Stack short results at the edge until you reach for them.

items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A top banner that rotates messages, counts down, and collapses smoothly when dismissed.

items.title: Cookie consent
items.description: A consent bar that morphs into preferences and folds into a reopen button.

items.title: Progress
items.description: Show how much of a known task is complete.

items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Reserve space while content is still loading.

items.title: Stepper
items.description: Show where a person is in a multi-step flow and what is done.

items.title: Countdown
items.description: A launch countdown with rolling digits that morphs into a live state at zero.

items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Show what fills an allowance and how close it is to the limit.

items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: Guide a new workspace through setup, one step at a time.

items.title: Avatar
items.description: A compact identity marker for people and accounts.

items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Show a team or set of contributors in a small space.

items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, category, or metadata.

items.title: Presence stack
items.description: Avatars of the people here now: joins pop in as the stack reflows, a counter rolls past the limit, dots show typing and idle, and hover fans it out with a gliding name label.

items.title: Card
items.description: A contained group of related content and actions.

items.title: Metric card
items.description: A compact summary for a number that needs context.

items.title: Empty state
items.description: A useful next step when there is nothing to show yet.

items.title: Line chart
items.description: A multi-series line chart with a gliding crosshair, legend toggles, and paths that morph between ranges.

items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Compare one measure across days and scrub any bar for its value.

items.title: Donut chart
items.description: A donut whose arcs morph between datasets, with the active value rolling into the center.

items.title: Streamgraph
items.description: Layered streams on a wiggle baseline that morph between ranges, with a layer you can isolate and read week by week.

items.title: Brush chart
items.description: A dense time series with an overview strip: drag a window to zoom, resize it by its handles, and read events in place.

items.title: Waffle chart
items.description: A ten by ten unit chart where every cell is one percent, and cells fly to their new group when the data changes.

items.title: Slope chart
items.description: Before and after on two axes: lines draw in, rank moves sit beside each value, and switching datasets slides every line to its new slope.

items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Show a compact trend beside a value.

items.title: Gauge
items.description: Show a value against a known range.

items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: See a year of activity at a glance, one square per day.

items.title: Animated counter
items.description: Give changing totals a clear sense of movement.

items.title: Ridgeline
items.description: Overlapping distributions, one ridge per group: hover to lift a ridge and read its quartiles, switch datasets and every curve morphs.

items.title: Treemap
items.description: A squarified treemap: click to drill and the tiles grow to fill the view, with a breadcrumb back and metrics that morph every tile.

items.title: Split bar
items.description: A single 100% bar split into shares: rest on a segment to widen it and read its exact figures, toggle segments from the legend and the rest reflow, with labels inside when they fit and on leader lines when they don't.

items.title: Sunburst
items.description: A hierarchy in rings: click a segment and every arc swings around it as the new centre, with a breadcrumb back and a rolling total.

items.title: Sankey flow
items.description: Flows between stages as ribbons with drifting particles; hover any node or ribbon to pour its share through the whole journey.

items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: A tapered conversion funnel with drop-off at every step, a device split that morphs the band, and dots that stream through it.

items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Two or three profiles on one web: shapes morph when you swap a profile, and a sweep across the axes compares values in place.

items.title: Realtime stream
items.description: A live line that scrolls at 60fps as readings arrive, holds still on hover to read, and pops a marker on every anomaly.

items.title: Race bar chart
items.description: A ranking over time: bars overtake each other on springs, values count up, and a timeline you can play or scrub.

items.title: Data grid
items.description: A spreadsheet grid with range selection, inline editing, a fill handle, and animated sorting.

items.title: Sortable data table
items.description: Compare structured records with sortable columns.

items.title: Tree table
items.description: A table with nested rows, tri-state selection, hierarchy-preserving sort, and lazy-loaded children.

items.title: Tree view
items.description: Navigate nested folders and structured content.

items.title: Reorderable list
items.description: Organize items with direct drag and drop.

items.title: Filter toolbar
items.description: Keep collection filters close and easy to reset.

items.title: Code block
items.description: Present code with legible hierarchy and copy access.

items.title: JSON viewer
items.description: A collapsible JSON tree with search, paging for long arrays, and copy value or path.

items.title: Timeline
items.description: Follow what happened, newest first, grouped by day.

items.title: Comment thread
items.description: Threaded comments with replies, reactions, mentions, inline edit, and resolve.

items.title: Chat thread
items.description: A chat thread with grouped messages, reactions, read receipts, typing, and a composer with attachments.

items.title: Image compare
items.description: Drag a divider across two images to see what changed.

items.title: Carousel
items.description: Browse a row of slides by dragging, flicking, or arrowing through them.

items.title: Card stack
items.description: Review a deck one card at a time, with a throw and an undo.

items.title: Text reveal
items.description: Reveal a short piece of content with restrained motion.

items.title: In-view title
items.description: Bring a section title in as it scrolls into view.

items.title: Text morph
items.description: Morph a label into its next state, letter by letter.

items.title: Text shimmer
items.description: Show ongoing work with a calm light across the words.

specialItems.title: Glass menu
specialItems.description: A glass action menu whose trigger morphs into the panel, with a highlight pill that glides between rows, one in-place submenu, and full keyboard support.

specialItems.title: Glass segmented
specialItems.description: A glass segmented control whose liquid indicator stretches between segments and can be dragged and flung.

specialItems.title: Glass card
specialItems.description: A glass info panel over a photo whose rim catches a pointer-following highlight while the card tilts; tap to morph it into a detail sheet.

specialItems.title: Glass tab bar
specialItems.description: A floating Liquid Glass tab bar that refracts what scrolls beneath it, with a glass lens that glides, magnifies and can be dragged between tabs, and an optional search bubble; it compacts on scroll down.

specialItems.title: Holo card
specialItems.description: A member card that tilts toward you with a holographic foil and flips to its back.

specialItems.title: Wallet stack
specialItems.description: Fan a stack of cards and lift one out to see its activity.

specialItems.title: Sheet stack
specialItems.description: Nested sheets that stack with depth, drag to dismiss, and become stacked dialogs on wide screens.

specialItems.title: Control center
specialItems.description: Workspace quick settings: tiles that morph into detail, a duration dial, and rubber-banded meters.

specialItems.title: Card to article
specialItems.description: Story cards that open into full articles with one seamless morph and shrink back into their exact slot when dragged down.

specialItems.title: Link unfurl
specialItems.description: A composer where pasting a URL shows a loading shimmer on the link, then unfurls it into a rich preview card with title, image and favicon in one morph, which can be collapsed back to the inline link or removed.

specialItems.title: Share sheet
specialItems.description: A Share button that opens into a panel with copy link, access level, channels, and people to send to.

specialItems.title: Action morph
specialItems.description: A floating button that morphs into a quick-action menu, then an inline form, then back with a check.

specialItems.title: Morph nav
specialItems.description: A navigation bar that morphs into rich menus, search, and a compact state as one surface.

specialItems.title: Dock
specialItems.description: A floating tool dock with a gliding label, a springy selection, and trays that grow out of it.

specialItems.title: Liquid tab bar
specialItems.description: Tabs with a lens selection that slides between them, swaps labels cleanly, and fills in icons as it passes.

specialItems.title: Orbit menu
specialItems.description: Hold a button and its actions orbit out, ready to pick with a drag.

specialItems.title: Orbit logos
specialItems.description: An integrations showcase with brand logos orbiting your product mark on tilted rings.

specialItems.title: Booking pill
specialItems.description: One pill that reshapes through party size, date, time, and a ticket.

specialItems.title: Keycap keyboard
specialItems.description: Mechanical keycaps that sink and light up as you type, with the text above the board.

specialItems.title: Slot text
specialItems.description: Text and numbers that spin into their new value on staggered slot machine reels.

specialItems.title: Sand text
specialItems.description: A headline made of sand that pours into the letters, crumbles where the cursor digs, and heals itself.

specialItems.title: Typewriter terminal
specialItems.description: A terminal that types a scripted CLI session with a seeded human cadence, colors the shell syntax, and streams output lines, progress bars and spinners, with a scrubber, play/pause and replay controls.

specialItems.title: Product gallery
specialItems.description: A product gallery with a hover magnifier, gliding thumbnails, and color and size variants that crossfade photos.

specialItems.title: Lightbox gallery
specialItems.description: A masonry grid where photos zoom from their slot into a viewer you can swipe, pinch, and drag away.

specialItems.title: Photo grid
specialItems.description: Pinch through zoom levels and open any photo straight from its cell.

specialItems.title: Cover flow
specialItems.description: A depth rail of images you can throw, with soft grounded shadows and a quiet reflection.

specialItems.title: Voice orb
specialItems.description: A voice mode orb that listens, thinks, and speaks, with a live transcript and call controls.

specialItems.title: Now playing
specialItems.description: Grow a mini player into the full player in one continuous morph.

specialItems.title: Voice recorder
specialItems.description: Record with a live waveform, review and scrub, then send the take into the thread.

specialItems.title: Page curl
specialItems.description: A small magazine you read by dragging page corners, with a real fold, lit curl, and flick to turn.

specialItems.title: Sticker peel
specialItems.description: Peel stickers off a surface with a real curl, move them around, and stick them back down.

specialItems.title: Dot grid
specialItems.description: A dot field that bulges around the cursor like a lens and ripples from every click.

specialItems.title: Gravity well
specialItems.description: A grid of tiles that bends toward the cursor like spacetime, with a click that sends a shockwave through it.

specialItems.title: Agent status
specialItems.description: A compact live status pill for a running AI agent: the agent's mark in a live ring, the current activity and an elapsed timer, opening into the steps so far.

specialItems.title: Tool call
specialItems.description: A tool call row for agent transcripts: the tool's mark and the call in plain words, a live state while it runs, and the input and output a click away, with approval and retry when needed.

specialItems.title: Agent plan
specialItems.description: The plan an agent writes before it acts: edit, reorder or add steps while it is a draft, then watch it work through them as a live checklist.

specialItems.title: Agent timeline
specialItems.description: A compact timeline of one orchestrated agent run: the orchestrator and its subagents share a time axis, handoffs draw in between rows, and a playhead replays thinking, tool calls and waiting while the header counts time, tokens and cost.

specialItems.title: Context window
specialItems.description: An AI context window as a grid of 200 cells: the system prompt, tools, files, summary and messages fill it in order, a threshold row marks where compaction starts, and sending a message, attaching a file or compacting shows exactly how much still fits.

specialItems.title: Ink fluid
specialItems.description: A real time fluid simulation behind your hero: the cursor stirs soft ink that swirls, settles and fades; calm when left alone.

specialItems.title: Activity rings
specialItems.description: Daily goals as tick rings that sweep, count up, and trace a second lap past 100%.

specialItems.title: Stretch refresh
specialItems.description: Pull a feed down and a line stretches to tell you when to let go.

specialItems.title: Morph loader
specialItems.description: Tiny loaders that morph between shapes and fold into a check or a cross when done.

specialItems.title: Skeleton morph
specialItems.description: Loading skeletons that grow into the real content, block by block, instead of swapping.

specialItems.title: Black hole
specialItems.description: A delete transition that pulls the chosen items into a tiny singularity while the rest of the list bends around it; undo spins them back out.

specialItems.title: Data flow
specialItems.description: Data flow illustration.

specialItems.title: Payment flow
specialItems.description: A card tap goes to a processor, then the network, then the bank and back with authorization, then settlement; each hop lights up with a status label and the amount travels as a chip.

specialItems.title: Multi-region failover
specialItems.description: Animated multi-region failover on a 2.5D stage: users stream requests through a global load balancer to two regions; the primary degrades, fails three health checks, traffic shifts smoothly to the healthy region, then it recovers, passes three checks and traffic ramps back to an even split.

specialItems.title: Vector search
specialItems.description: Documents drop onto a tilted embedding plane and fold into points that cluster by topic; the index links neighbours, a query is typed, embedded and lowered onto the plane, a signal hops along the graph toward it, and a widening ring lights the nearest documents with connecting lines, similarity scores and a ranked list.

specialItems.title: Agent loop
specialItems.description: An illustration of the agent loop: gather context, take action, verify, repeat, with a bright head circling three stations around the model.

specialItems.title: Mixture of experts
specialItems.description: An illustration of mixture of experts routing: each token is scored by a router, travels to its top experts, and their outputs merge into the token's result.

specialItems.title: Speculative decoding
specialItems.description: An illustration of speculative decoding: a fast draft model guesses a few tokens, the target model checks them in one pass, and accepted guesses join the answer.

specialItems.title: Prompt cache
specialItems.description: An animated explainer for prompt caching: the shared prefix of each request is cached once, later requests read it back, and the cost and time saved add up.

specialItems.title: Reasoning tree
specialItems.description: An illustration of tree search over thoughts: candidates are scored, weak branches fade, the best expand, and the winning path from question to answer draws in.

specialItems.title: Time dial
specialItems.description: Spin a dial to pick an hour and see which team cities are at work.

specialItems.title: Date reel
specialItems.description: A 3D wheel date and time picker (like iOS reels) with momentum scrolling, snapping, curved perspective, and full keyboard support.

blockItems.title: Site footer

blockItems.title: Logo marquee
blockItems.description: A quiet, continuously moving row of brand marks with a pause control.

blockItems.title: Page header

blockItems.title: Hero signup

blockItems.title: Spotlight grid

blockItems.title: Scroll story
blockItems.description: A feature section where scrolling the copy drives a pinned product view through each step.

blockItems.title: Feature bento
blockItems.description: A six cell feature bento where small, real product UI acts each feature out on hover.

blockItems.title: Plan comparison

blockItems.description: A seat slider and billing toggle drive plan cards with rolling prices and a moving recommended badge.

blockItems.title: Product detail
blockItems.description: A product page with a swipeable gallery, finish and size variants, add to bag that confirms in place, shipping, a reviews summary, and details.

blockItems.title: Cart drawer
blockItems.description: Products fly into the cart, counts roll, and a drawer handles quantities, shipping progress, and checkout.

blockItems.title: Checkout summary
blockItems.description: An order summary with a promo code that becomes a chip, discount and tax lines, and pay button states.

blockItems.title: Usage pricing
blockItems.description: A pricing calculator that finds your plan as you drag seats and traffic.

blockItems.description: A usage based billing dashboard with a projected spend line, meters against limits, alerts, and an upgrade that morphs into a confirm sheet.

blockItems.title: Wallet card
blockItems.description: A compact account view with balance, recent activity, and focused money actions.

blockItems.title: Invoice studio
blockItems.description: An editable invoice with live totals and a clear save flow.

blockItems.title: Delivery tracker
blockItems.description: A live order tracker whose marker glides between stops while the arrival time rolls.

blockItems.title: Cancel flow
blockItems.description: A cancellation flow that answers each reason with a tailored offer and a calm hold-to-cancel.

blockItems.title: Integrations
blockItems.description: An integrations directory where Connect morphs to Connected and the filters recount as you go.

blockItems.title: Help center
blockItems.description: A help center with instant search, topic cards, and popular articles that open into a readable article with an outline and feedback.

blockItems.description: An in-app help launcher that grows into live article search, reading, and a chat with your team.

blockItems.title: Support conversation
blockItems.description: A responsive message thread with useful quick replies and live feedback.

blockItems.title: Changelog feed
blockItems.description: Release notes you can filter, open in place, and scroll through month by month.

blockItems.title: Empty states

blockItems.title: Billing overview
blockItems.description: A billing page where the plan card morphs into a picker and usage, invoices, and card follow.

blockItems.title: Workspace sidebar
blockItems.description: A product sidebar with a workspace switcher, live search, draggable favorites, and inline projects.

blockItems.description: Account settings with a gliding section nav and a save bar that morphs in as you edit.

blockItems.title: Settings command
blockItems.description: Workspace settings where a search field grows into a palette that flies you to any setting.

blockItems.description: A docs layout with a live filtering nav tree, version switcher, and a gliding on this page outline.

blockItems.title: Inbox sidebar

blockItems.description: Process a focused inbox with archive, snooze, and restore actions.

blockItems.title: Command palette
blockItems.description: A complete keyboard driven action surface with search, grouped results, and shortcuts.

blockItems.title: Notification center
blockItems.description: A home for updates with read state, grouped information, and animated disclosure.

blockItems.title: Selection toolbar
blockItems.description: A contextual batch action surface that appears when items are selected.

blockItems.title: File upload
blockItems.description: A complete file selection flow with constraints, progress, and error feedback.

blockItems.title: OTP input
blockItems.description: A six digit verification flow with paste support and keyboard navigation.

blockItems.title: Multi-step form
blockItems.description: A guided form that presents one decision at a time and preserves progress.

blockItems.description: An account creation flow with field validation, password strength, and a clear completion state.

blockItems.title: Sign in
blockItems.description: A sign in card that morphs from email to a six digit code to your account.

blockItems.title: Centered login
blockItems.description: A passkey-first login card on a quiet ring backdrop that morphs through email and code.

blockItems.title: Immersive login
blockItems.description: A glass magic link card over dusk photography that folds its envelope shut once sent.

blockItems.title: Login split
blockItems.description: A full screen split login: an email-first form that morphs into a password step beside a photo.

blockItems.title: Security settings
blockItems.description: An account security page with guided two-factor setup, password change and active sessions.

blockItems.title: Search results
blockItems.description: A faceted workspace search page with suggestions, facet counts that follow the query, filter chips, mixed doc, person and file results with highlighted matches, a gliding keyboard cursor and a preview pane.

blockItems.title: Media player
blockItems.description: An audio player with a living playlist and complete playback controls.

blockItems.title: Team directory
blockItems.description: Searchable people, team filters, and a focused profile panel.

blockItems.title: Team showcase
blockItems.description: An image led team introduction with profiles that open in place.

blockItems.title: Studio perspectives
blockItems.description: Portrait led editorial stories with a focused reading state.

blockItems.title: Team members
blockItems.description: A members list where typed emails turn into chips and fly into pending invites as seats roll.

blockItems.title: Invite people
blockItems.description: Invite teammates with roles, bulk paste validation, a seat meter, and avatars that fly into a pending list.

blockItems.title: Availability picker
blockItems.description: Find a meeting time across people and see the choice come together.

blockItems.title: Project board
blockItems.description: A living workflow board for moving work between stages.

blockItems.title: Kanban board
blockItems.description: A kanban board where cards lift, tilt and spring into the slot that opens for them, with swimlanes and live WIP limits.

blockItems.title: Week calendar
blockItems.description: A week calendar where you drag to create, move, and resize events, with color coded calendars, day and agenda views, and swipes on phones.

blockItems.title: API keys
blockItems.description: API key management where Create key unfolds into its form and each secret is shown once.

blockItems.title: Webhooks
blockItems.description: A webhooks console with delivery history, a payload inspector and retries that roll the rate.

blockItems.title: Roles and permissions
blockItems.description: A permissions matrix with group toggles that ripple, role duplication and a review bar.

blockItems.title: Environment variables
blockItems.description: An environment variables and secrets manager with masked values, per-environment scope toggles, .env paste import with duplicate and invalid key warnings, write-only sensitive values, an environment diff by fingerprint, and a redeploy banner.

blockItems.title: Release readiness
blockItems.description: A launch checklist that keeps prerequisites, progress, and the final action together.

blockItems.title: Onboarding illustration
blockItems.description: A compact onboarding card whose line illustration morphs from folder to files, team, and badge.

blockItems.title: Cohort retention
blockItems.description: A cohort retention triangle that morphs into retention curves and rewashes by segment.

blockItems.title: Metrics dashboard
blockItems.description: A dense analytics view with KPI tabs, one inspectable chart, and top pages and sources.

blockItems.title: Revenue explorer
blockItems.description: A SaaS revenue chart you zoom with a brush while paths, axes and figures glide to the range.

blockItems.title: Journey flow
blockItems.description: A Sankey of user journeys whose flows morph by channel and trace a cohort on hover.

blockItems.title: Usage forecast
blockItems.description: A billing period usage chart with a forecast cone and a draggable budget that dates the crossing.

blockItems.title: MRR waterfall
blockItems.description: An MRR bridge whose floating bars morph by period and open the accounts behind each move.

blockItems.title: Metric explorer
blockItems.description: KPI cards that open into a scrubbable chart and morph between metrics and ranges.

blockItems.title: Activity terrain
blockItems.description: A 3D terrain of hourly activity you can orbit, zoom, fly into and flatten into a heatmap.

blockItems.title: Revenue globe
blockItems.description: A dotted globe where live payments arc home to headquarters, with a replayable day.

blockItems.title: Customer galaxy
blockItems.description: 2,400 accounts as a drifting galaxy that spirals into clusters by plan, region or health.

blockItems.title: Semantic zoom
blockItems.description: An infinite-zoom map of a company that reveals teams, projects, tasks and people as you fly in.

blockItems.title: Layout morph
blockItems.description: A 24 card gallery that flies between grid, masonry, list, fan, carousel and a 3D helix.

blockItems.title: Budget variance
blockItems.description: Budget against actual operating spend by department as aligned bullet charts, with favorable and unfavorable variance, a month, quarter and year to date switch that springs every bar, in-place drill-down into budget lines, and a total row.

blockItems.title: Choropleth explorer
blockItems.description: A filled-region map that shades every state or region by revenue, growth or penetration on a stepped scale, with a country switch (United States, Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Australia), a hoverable legend, a synced ranked list and a camera zoom into local detail.

blockItems.title: Small multiples
blockItems.description: A trellis of small line charts that reads as one chart, with a synced crosshair, a shared or independent y scale that springs the axes, sorting with a FLIP reorder, a ghost of the overall total behind every panel and dimming for flat trends.

blockItems.title: Connected scatter
blockItems.description: A connected scatterplot of monthly CAC against LTV where the path draws itself in, a scrubber moves a head along the curve, and a channel switch morphs the path against a shaded 3x target line.

blockItems.title: Horizon chart
blockItems.description: A horizon chart that stacks fourteen daily series as compact folded rows, with a synced crosshair, a sort by name, peak or latest, a band count setting that folds every row on one spring, and a legend that explains how to read the bands.

blockItems.title: Line replay
blockItems.description: A time replay line chart that draws a day of traffic with a moving playhead, a value label on the tip, a scrubber, speed control and key moments annotated as the playhead passes them.

blockItems.title: Exploded view
blockItems.description: A scroll driven exploded view where a live phone screen built from five CSS 3D layers lies back, separates in depth with labels that follow each layer, takes each layer into focus, and then reassembles.

blockItems.title: KPI drilldown
blockItems.description: KPI cards that expand into a full detail chart with period comparison and a breakdown table, then fold back.

blockItems.title: Market terminal
blockItems.description: A trading terminal with a canvas candlestick chart, volume, moving averages, crosshair OHLC readout, wheel, drag and pinch zoom, a live watchlist with sparklines and flashing prices, and a market and limit order ticket.

blockItems.title: AI composer
blockItems.description: The prompt box at the bottom of an AI app: files upload in place, / opens commands, @ inserts mentions, a model and effort menu sits in the toolbar, and the send button turns into a stop control ringed by the reply's progress.

blockItems.title: AI chat
blockItems.description: A full-screen AI chat where answers stream in as markdown with folding reasoning, tool chips and cited sources.

blockItems.title: AI side panel
blockItems.description: An assistant docked beside a page that reads it and edits it: ask about the page or a selected passage, review each edit as a word diff, and apply it with a tint sweep on the page and one-click undo.

blockItems.title: Research run
blockItems.description: Deep research that plans searches, reads sources with their marks, and streams a cited answer where every chip lights up the sentence it supports.

blockItems.title: AI answer
blockItems.description: One AI answer set like a clean article: it thinks, shows its sources as small cards with colored marks, and streams a formatted answer where every citation lights the sentence it supports.

blockItems.title: Model picker
blockItems.description: A model picker in one quiet pill: open it to choose from featured models with a one line note each, set the reasoning effort, or browse every other model by provider, and the pill swaps to your choice in place.

blockItems.title: Model arena
blockItems.description: A blind side by side model comparison in one card: send one prompt to two models, watch both answers stream at the same pace, vote for the better one, then reveal which model wrote each.

blockItems.title: Prompt studio
blockItems.description: One card for editing, testing and shipping a prompt template: variables as chips with sample values, a test run against the chosen model, and versions you can compare and promote to production.

blockItems.title: Document extraction
blockItems.description: Turns a document into typed data with a model and shows where every value came from: fields fill in as the page is read, and hovering a value lights its source on the PDF.

blockItems.title: Agent memory
blockItems.description: One card for what an assistant remembers about you: filter and search memories, edit or forget one in place, and turn saved memories and chat history on or off.

blockItems.title: Agent tasks
blockItems.description: A home for background coding agents: start a task on a repository and branch, watch each card move from queued to running to ready for review, and open a pull request from the result.

blockItems.title: Agent approvals
blockItems.description: One approval card for agents: the waiting tool call reads like a permission prompt with the tool's mark, the agent's reason and its arguments, and you approve, deny or allow it from now on.

blockItems.title: Agent routines
blockItems.description: Scheduled agents in one card: each routine reads as a sentence with its schedule, next run countdown, connectors and destination, and opens smoothly to edit or run it now.

blockItems.title: Agent orchestrator
blockItems.description: A lead agent splits a goal into a plan, fans the subtasks out to parallel worker lanes and merges what comes back, with each lane's model, progress and result in view.

blockItems.title: MCP servers
blockItems.description: Manage the MCP servers that give an agent its tools: see what the enabled tools cost in context, connect or pause a server, and switch single tools on or off.

blockItems.title: Knowledge base
blockItems.description: A retrieval knowledge base in one card: add sources and watch them parse, chunk, embed and index, then test a question and see which chunks come back and why.

blockItems.title: Eval suite
blockItems.description: Run an evaluation suite on a new version of an LLM feature against its baseline: results stream in case by case, and regressions and fixes are called out with the cases behind them.

blockItems.title: Agent run
blockItems.description: A single card that follows one AI coding agent through a task: steps stream in with the live one shimmering, tool calls open in place, and the agent stops on a two-file diff for you to approve or send back before it writes.
